name: app-solar-energy-app-in-hand-over-giant-white-wordmark
title: Green energy app held in a hand with floating glass notifications over a huge white wordmark
whatItIs: A green gradient with a giant white cropped 'cubee' behind, a hand holding a phone whose dark green UI shows a savings figure, an app icon, a gauge, and stats. Frosted glass notification cards float outside the phone.
whatItMeans: Fresh and smart; green glow and glass alerts say clean energy and instant feedback.
techniques: Put a huge cropped wordmark behind the device.
Float glass notifications beside the phone.
Keep the palette in green tones.
Show a savings number as the hero.

vocabulary.definition: A translucent alert card outside the phone.
A giant brand name cut by the frame.
A single big figure as focal point.
